metadata.source: KOAN / UoN / SGS Kenya / MOH Advisory MOH/ADM/1/2/52

moh_advisory_solution.target_recipients: All CECM-Health, All County Directors of Health (CDH), All Chief Officers for Health (COH)

five_county_actions.title: 1. Market Surveillance
five_county_actions.description: Intensify inspection and sampling of fresh produce at major county markets (Kale, Spinach, Tomatoes, Onions).
five_county_actions.safeplate_solution: RAMANI 2.0 Real-time market risk radar mapping high-probability contamination nodes and sampling schedules.

five_county_actions.title: 2. Public Communication
five_county_actions.description: Disseminate household preparation guidelines reducing pesticide residues by 60-70% via thorough washing, soaking, and peeling.
five_county_actions.safeplate_solution: OSHA Consumer Wash Calculator & visual infographics demonstrating 60-70% residue removal with salt, vinegar, or baking soda.

five_county_actions.title: 3. Trader & Producer Coordination
five_county_actions.description: Engage county produce traders and farmer associations to reinforce MRL awareness and Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) compliance.
five_county_actions.safeplate_solution: SHAMBA Organic Switchboard generating crop-specific PHI compliance calendars and biopesticide substitution schedules.

five_county_actions.title: 4. Inspection Capacity Reporting
five_county_actions.description: Submit a summary of current market inspection capacity and produce-testing data to the Ministry of Health.
five_county_actions.safeplate_solution: TAKWIMU Automated Digital Reporting Portal exporting verified county inspection capacity logs.

five_county_actions.title: 5. Inter-Agency Referral Pathway
five_county_actions.description: Establish formal referral pathways to PCPB and KEPHIS when local residue levels of concern are identified.
five_county_actions.safeplate_solution: One-click digital referral gateway dispatching verified laboratory violation flags directly to PCPB and KEPHIS inspectorships.
